newsitem.title: RWANDA: Grenade blast kills three in Rwandan capital bar.
newsitem.headline: Grenade blast kills three in Rwandan capital bar.

text.p: A hand grenade thrown into a bar in the Rwandan capital killed three people and wounded six, police and officials said on Thursday.
Police officers said the grenade was thrown into the bar in the Kichukiro-Gikondo district of Kigali at about 11.30 p.m. on Wednesday night when it was still packed with drinkers.
"The suspect ran off and we do not believe he has yet been caught," said Pascal Masabo, a district official at the scene.
An upsurge of violence in Rwanda in the past two months has killed hundreds of Rwandans and at least six expatriates but has been largely restricted to areas outside the capital Kigali.
A senior judge and vice president of the supreme court, Vincent Nzezabaganwa, was shot dead last week at his Kigali home with three other people.
